Substitution for Chairman of Kayah State Investment Committee
U Bosco, Acting Chief Minister, the Kayah State Government has been appointed
as the Chairman of Kayah State Investment Committee which was formed by the
Notification No. 49/2017 of the Myanmar Investment Commission.
